messages:
anika_product: Quick heads-up — mid-q reforecast ask. Acme pilot (enterprise) is hitting onboarding deadlines and we need stronger latency guarantees. Proposal: reallocate 20% of Dedicated capacity from the 'Experimentation' OKR pool to 'Enterprise SLA' for the next 6 weeks. This is to support their P0 traffic window. Need product+eng+finance sign-off by EOD tomorrow.

sam_product: Can you share expected customer impact vs what we lose on experimentation? 20% feels material to the experiments roadmap.

anika_product: Yes — high level: Acme pilot is revenue-enabled and timeboxed. If we don't reallocate they'll pause the pilot and push launch. Experiments will see slower throughput for low-priority jobs but nonblocking. Estimated customer-revenue at stake ~ $120k ARR if pilot stalls.

liam_eng: Tech note: moving reserved Dedicated slices is doable, but we'll need a config change and a short rolling restart for the dedicated pool. Risk: 99th pct latency may increase briefly during the move. Rollback plan: revert slice allocation and failover to Hosted fallback policy. Canary for 48h required.

maya_research: Also a quick win: if we apply 4-bit quantization for the experimentation model variants we can recoup ~12% capacity, might soften the hit. That would reduce the effective shift to ~8% net. I'll run evals tonight. :mag:

jorge_sre: Monitoring checklist if we do this: token latency heatmaps, queue length alert at 80% of new cap, and autoscaler cooldown bump. We need a post-change runbook and an on-call rotation starter for the first 72h.

katie_finance: Rough cost delta: shifting 20% Dedicated for 6 weeks increases reserved spend by `+$9.6k` (we'd accelerate committed usage), but offsets potential lost pilot revenue. If Maya's quantization lands, net spend delta drops to `+$3.4k`. I'll attach a formal P&L in the doc.

anika_product: Thanks. Can we translate to clear acceptance criteria? My proposal: Approve only if (1) Eng commits to 48h canary + rollback plan, (2) SRE provides runbook and monitors, (3) Finance signs off on the spend delta. If all three, we move forward.

sam_product: Conditional approve from product side on those 3 bullets. Please capture the canary start window (we prefer 10pm PDT Friday) and a hard stop if latency > 150% of baseline for > 10m. :white_check_mark:

liam_eng: Agree to 48h canary. We can start Friday 22:00 PDT. I'll own the rollback automation and post the commands in the runbook. Example command we'll use: 
```
redwoodctl capacity set --pool dedicated-experiments --pct 60
redwoodctl capacity set --pool dedicated-enterprise --pct 40
```
We'll also tag the rollout with `canary/acme-pilot`.

jorge_sre: I'll draft the runbook and add the monitoring dashboards. On-call rotation: Liam + me for first 24h, then normal SRE.

katie_finance: Finance signs off on the spend delta given the revenue risk. Approving.

anika_product: Great — product approves conditional on the items locked above. Liam/Jorge/Katie are official approvers. I'll mark this in the roadmap reforecast and notify sales.

infra-bot: Note: change scheduled Friday 2026-03-27 22:00 PDT. Automations queued. :robot_face:

sam_product: Thanks everyone — I'll update the OKR tracker and ping Acme with the canary window.

anika_product: Closing thread once runbook link is live. :handshake:
